/cofounder.html.mainText: CTO Co-founder Position @ Ixaria Own the technical direction of our platform as we build a product intelligence layer for furniture e-commerce. On this page The role About Ixaria What you will do AI & LLM responsibility What we look for The most important quality You are a good fit if What's in it for you How do we start Meet the team The role A builder's role, not a spectator's Ixaria is looking for a CTO (with the potential to become a co-founder) to own the technical direction of our platform as we build a product intelligence layer for furniture e-commerce. 99% Execution & Testing 1% Strategy This role is for someone who is super passionate about building tech products and obsessed with creating ones that are used and really add value to their customers. This role is for someone who has always wanted to own their own business & build a tech startup with a global & scalable product used by millions of people. About us About Ixaria Ixaria is building a product intelligence system for furniture manufacturers. Ixaria helps furniture manufacturers centralize product and component data, understand how customers interact with their websites, and render better product pages based on customer behavior, needs, buying stage, and context. We are not building a standard webshop, a simple product configurator, or a collection of client-specific projects. We are building a scalable platform that integrates with existing e-commerce systems and combines structured product data, behavioral intelligence, and AI-assisted capabilities. We are a small core team, so this role has a major impact. The person joining Ixaria will help define how the platform is built, how AI becomes part of the product, how the technical team grows, and ultimately what the company becomes. Responsibilities What you will do You will be responsible for the architecture, development, and technical evolution of the Ixaria platform. This includes: Owning the overall technical architecture and development strategy Building and improving integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, and other e-commerce platforms Developing plugins, applications, APIs, and integration layers for existing webshops Working across backend systems, frontend applications, databases, infrastructure, and third-party services Designing the systems used to collect, validate, store, and retrieve structured product and component data Building the technical foundation for adaptive product page experiences Developing the event and data infrastructure required to understand customer journeys and website behavior Ensuring that client implementations become reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off custom solutions Establishing standards for scalability, performance, security, testing, and maintainable development Working closely with product, design, analytics, and commercial leadership Helping define the technical team and development processes as Ixaria grows AI & LLM AI and LLM responsibility AI and LLM-based capabilities will be an important part of Ixaria's technical direction. You will be responsible for defining how these technologies are integrated into the platform in a reliable, controlled, and commercially useful way. This may include: Building AI-assisted workflows for structuring, classifying, enriching, and validating product data Using LLMs to identify missing product information and generate suggested customer-facing explanations Developing retrieval systems that allow AI models to answer questions using approved product and component data Contributing to the development of an AI product assistant for complex furniture products Using behavioral and product data to support customer segmentation and product page adaptation Evaluating when to use third-party models, hosted services, retrieval-augmented generation, or internally controlled systems Designing validation, approval, monitoring, and fallback mechanisms for AI-generated outputs Preventing hallucinations and ensuring that sensitive claims remain grounded in manufacturer-approved information Managing model costs, latency, reliability, data privacy, and observability Turning AI prototypes into dependable product capabilities We are not looking for someone who simply adds a chatbot to the platform. We need someone who understands how AI systems should interact with structured data, business rules, user behavior, and human approval processes. Requirements What we are looking for We are looking for someone with strong technical judgment, broad full-stack experience, and the ability to think like a product builder. You should have strong experience with: Java & backend development JavaScript & TypeScript Angular React or comparable frameworks API architecture & integrations Databases & data modeling Data-intensive applications Cloud infrastructure & deployment E-commerce systems & integration patterns Shopify / WooCommerce Plugin / app development for third-party ecosystems Performance, scalability & security Maintainable software architecture Practical knowledge of modern AI application development, including some of: LLM APIs & model integration Retrieval-augmented generation Embeddings & vector search Prompt & context management Structured outputs & tool calling Evaluation & monitoring of AI outputs AI workflow orchestration Data privacy & security in AI apps Experience with WebGL, Three.js, 3D product visualization, or product configurators is valuable, but not mandatory. We do not require someone who trains foundation models from scratch. We need someone who knows how to design, evaluate, and operate dependable AI-enabled product features. Mindset The most important quality The most important quality we are looking for is entrepreneurial spirit. We need someone who does not wait for a complete specification before taking responsibility. Someone who can understand the business problem, challenge assumptions, propose solutions, and help decide what the product should become. You should be able to look at a client request and ask: Does this solve a wider problem? Should this become part of the platform? Can this be built as a reusable capability? Does AI add real value here, or would a deterministic system work better? How do we deliver something useful now without damaging the long-term architecture? What are the technical and commercial trade-offs? This is a leadership role with direct influence over both the technology and the company's direction. Fit You are a good fit if You want to build and shape a product, not only complete development tasks You can move comfortably between architecture, implementation, and business discussions You understand the difference between an AI demonstration and a reliable AI product You care about clean architecture without being blocked by perfection You know how to balance speed, technical debt, and long-term scalability You can communicate technical decisions clearly to non-technical colleagues You are comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete information You want substantial ownership in an early-stage company You are interested in e-commerce, product intelligence, behavioral data, and AI Why join What's in it for you Learn the business of a startup You'll learn the business behind building a tech startup, first-hand. Grow 10x faster Your limits will be tested constantly, and you'll grow in 1 year as much as you would in 10 years in a safe & secure 9-5 job. We can guarantee that! A personal development marathon You'll have one of the best personal development marathons ever. Become a significant shareholder You have the opportunity to become a significant shareholder in Ixaria and earn co-founder status if you're truly dedicated, have a founder mindset, and are proactive in what you do. Process How do we start? 1 Test our chemistry We will test our chemistry in 1-2 months, with 100-200 hours of work. 2 Agree on the details If it's a go on both sides, we will decide on the details about your involvement, and propose an equity plan vested over a period of 5 years, with a 1-year cliff. The team Meet the team you'll work with Alexandru Meseșan Co-founder & CEO LinkedIn Victor Iancu Co-founder & Tech LinkedIn Eduard Badea Co-founder & Product LinkedIn Advisors Adrian Gheorghe Advisor LinkedIn Ready to build something that lasts? If you have the founder mindset, the technical range, and the drive to own the product, we'd love to hear from you. Send us an email at alex@ixaria.ro

No spam. Only practical ideas about furniture ecommerce, product pages, and conversion.Built by Builders.Based in the industrial heart of Timisoara, Ixaria was founded by Alex, Victor & Eduard with a single mission: to protect the legacy of European manufacturing from digital obsolescence.AlexVision, SalesLinkedIn ↗VictorTechnical LeadLinkedIn ↗EduardProductLinkedIn ↗Frequently asked questionsHow the solution works / what it does?Ixaria helps more interested visitors become buyers through three connected steps: Signals, Correlations and Responses.Signals: learn what matters to each shopper. Small interactive elements, such as buttons or images, help visitors explore what interests them. Their choices across your webshop and return visits reveal more about their needs.Correlations: connect the clues. Ixaria uses AI to connect these interactions with the visitor’s context, including where they came from and the campaign that brought them there. Together, these clues help identify what they may need before deciding.Responses: show information that helps. Ixaria adapts the page with relevant content and visuals. For example, someone exploring practical fabrics might see cleaning guidance, while someone concerned about size might see an image showing the sofa’s scale.We build and refine these interactions using research and real customer behaviour, then measure what helps visitors move towards a purchase.How is Ixaria implemented in our webshop?We add a simple script to your webshop to analyse incoming traffic and follow visitor behaviour. We then add small interactive elements, called signals, where relevant across your homepage, product listings and product pages.Based on what we learn, Ixaria displays predefined responses on product pages—for example, shipping reassurance near the buy button. Your team can design these elements or customise our templates to match your brand.How do you know which stage of the buying journey a customer is in?We connect where visitors come from with what they do on your website. If they arrive through an ad, we consider its message to understand their expectations. Their interactions and number of visits then help us estimate their buying stage and what they may need next.Will Ixaria change our website’s design? How do we keep control of our brand?Ixaria adds small elements, such as buttons, short quizzes and information blocks, within your existing website. Your team can customise our templates to match your brand guidelines, including your colours, fonts and visual style.Does Ixaria also change landing pages, category pages, product listings or search?Yes, small interactive signals can be added across your webshop, depending on the use case. These help us understand what visitors need. Product pages remain our main focus: they adapt based on what we learn throughout the buying journey.Do we need to replace our existing product information or asset management systems?No. During the audit, we review your existing tools and how your information is organised. We then plan how to connect that information to Ixaria. You can keep your current systems.Can pages adapt to different countries or markets?Yes. Ixaria considers the visitor’s country or region alongside their behaviour. We connect this context with our research on shopper psychology and cultural differences to adapt information to local expectations and individual needs.How long does it take to launch Ixaria?We work in three stages. The audit takes seven days. This is followed by a three-month pilot, during which we integrate Ixaria and test it with real visitors. After the pilot, we move to full implementation.How soon can we see results?The first results come during the pilot. By the end of the three-month pilot, we review the findings and assess how Ixaria has affected customer behaviour and conversion.Does Ixaria work for both freestanding and fitted furniture?Ixaria is built for movable furniture sold in series, including products with configurable options. It is not designed for fitted furniture or fully bespoke, made-to-order projects.What work does the Ixaria team handle?We handle the process from understanding your business to implementing the solution. During the audit, we review your webshop, customers and existing systems. During the pilot, we manage the full integration and setup.Can Ixaria help if we already have a 3D configurator?Yes. Ixaria can work alongside any existing 3D product configurator. You can keep your configurator while Ixaria adapts the surrounding product-page experience.Do we need to replace our ecommerce platform?No. Ixaria works on top of your existing ecommerce platform, so you can keep your current webshop.
